other_conditions: The applicant must be the family (legal heir) of the missing fisherman.
The missing fisherman must have died while fishing.
The missing fisherman must not have been a beneficiary of the old age pension scheme.
The missing fisherman should be enrolled as a member of the Fishermen/Fisherwomen Co-operative Society.
The family must apply within 30 days from the date of the event.
benefits_summary: A total of ₹1,00,000 is provided as immediate relief, disbursed in two installments of ₹50,000 each to the family (legal heir) of the missing fisherman.
documents_required: Self‑attested copies of all mandatory documents
